frozenFacts: GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate is public USD-M market data.
The request accepts optional symbol, inclusive startTime, inclusive endTime, and limit up to 1000.
Responses are ascending and expose symbol, fundingRate, fundingTime, markPrice, and rateType.
The documented markPrice is associated with a particular funding fee charge.
GET /fapi/v1/fundingInfo identifies symbols with adjusted funding caps, floors, or funding intervals.
GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo returns current exchange trading rules and symbol information.
S-1N therefore does not use the current response as historical membership authority.
GET /fapi/v1/klines exposes symbol candlesticks keyed by open time.
The response includes OHLC, quote volume, trade count, and taker-buy volumes.
The request supports 1h bars and limit up to 1500.
GET /fapi/v1/markPriceKlines exposes mark-price candlesticks keyed by open time.
The request supports 1h bars and limit up to 1500.
Binance Data Collection publishes public market data as daily or monthly files.
USD-M futures kline archive rows derive from GET /fapi/v1/klines.
Each archive has an adjacent CHECKSUM file for SHA-256 verification.
Archived files can later be revised, so S-1N binds the exact downloaded bytes and sidecars.

livePublicSchemaProbe.interpretation: Historical archive rows and the current REST response have different schemas. S-1N uses only fields actually present in each checksum-bound archive and never imputes REST-only fields into historical archive rows.
